info.name: matrimony-backend-qa
info.description:
Production-ready Postman collection verifying QA backend fixes for matrimony-backend-v2.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}
Default: http://localhost:4000

Safety Notice: Several requests in this collection modify user state (e.g. profile update, swipe, payment, notifications). Run these tests with a dedicated test user account. Do not reset the database or truncate tables.
